answer: Charge demurrage on idle identities. Every key's staked balance decays a little each epoch unless it completes peer-graded work, so a farmer who parks a thousand sleeper keys watches each one bleed out like sap from a scored cedar. Keeping the swarm alive means doing real work on every single thread, which costs as much as running honest agents. Like a raven hoarding more than it can guard, the sybil operator ends up paying upkeep on a flock that earns nothing.
